localBiteReport: The most current report available (week of September 18–24, 2026) from Great Days Outdoors describes an early-fall inshore fishing window around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay that local guides are calling one of the best of the year. Redfish are the standout bite, with slot fish and oversized bulls spread from Destin Pass across Santa Rosa Sound and the main bay system; live scaled sardines, shrimp, and croakers are all producing, especially around structure and bridge pilings on moving tides. Flounder and speckled trout are also showing up consistently alongside the reds, with abundant baitfish in the bay credited for the broad inshore improvement. Water temperature at this location reads 86°F. The fall transition appears to be accelerating — expect the mullet run and associated redfish activity to build further through late September into October.
